gap_details.2011-2012: 2011-12..2017-18 resident list (FatWire content block cid=1307369094954) never archived; phase 2 re-audited 2011-2019: 4,074 Wayback content_block captures (no neurosurgery block; nearby cids 1306073859695/712, 1307369092771, 1307969208400/9746 are unrelated), 134 level-4 pages, old rush.edu/professionals/gme/ (resident photo files 404 by 2013), rushu GME and department paths, rush.edu/news. Independent evidence instead: alumni list 2001-2026 (complete per class), PubMed affiliation mining 2010-2019 (737 papers, every non-faculty name checked), and cross-program rosters. Found: David Wallace (2012 entrant, left after PGY3 2014-15 to UT San Antonio, from his UTHSA bio) and Owoicho Adogwa was a Duke resident 2012-15 who joined Rush at PGY4 in 2015-16 (he had been wrongly reconstructed as a 2012 Rush entrant). Every entry class now matches the complement (2 per year to 2013, then alternating 3/2: 2014 3, 2015 2, 2016 3, 2017 2), so no open slot suggests another unseen departure.

gap_details.2018-2019: Observed via Aug 2019 capture (first ever capture of meet-our-residents); CONTENT-DATED 2018-19 (Kerolus/Kochanski PGY6, become PGY7 in Dec 2019). No capture during 2018-19 itself; whether all 2018-19 residents were shown is unverifiable.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page fetched 2026-09-28 (re-fetch; identical to 2026-09-27 save): advanced (Barrett, Shepherd new PGY1; Kolcun/Kolb gone). Kazuki Sakakura still listed PGY-1 (PGY-1 in 2025-26 too).

departures.note: NEW phase 2. Entry 2012 (Rush MD 2012). UTHSA bio: 'Residency - Rush University Medical Center, Department of Neurosurgery (2012-2015)' (https://web.archive.org/web/20201020235207/https://lsom.uthscsa.edu/neurosurgery/team-member/david-wallace-md/). TRANSFERRED to UT Health San Antonio (108): PGY4 2016-17, graduated 2020. Recorded in training_history.

departures.name: Ravi Nunna
departures.note: entry 2015; absent Dec 2019; not on alumni list. PubMed: UIC neurosurgery (research) 2020-22, then Missouri. TRANSFERRED to University of Missouri-Columbia (94): PGY5 2022-23, graduated 2025. Recorded.

departures.name: Ayodamola Otun
departures.note: entry 2022; absent Aug 2024 onward; not on alumni list. NPPES (2025-04) lists Anesthesiology, Milwaukee WI, but NPI only: destination unconfirmed (not on MCW anesthesiology pages checked). Recorded as completed=no, departure unknown.

departures.name: Joseph Morrison
departures.note: entry 2018; absent Aug 2024 onward; not on alumni list. NPPES (2024-07) trainee in Aurora CO, but not on the Colorado neurosurgery roster (80) 2024-27. Destination unknown. Recorded. NB: 16_adjudicate matches him to John Morrison (Buffalo 2018) by initial+surname and prints TRANSFERRED (Buffalo); that is wrong.

departures.name: Mychael Delgardo
departures.note: PGY-1 Aug 2024-May 2025; absent Jul 2025 onward; no Rush-affiliated papers. Outcome unknown. Recorded.

joiners.name: Owoicho Adogwa
joiners.note: NEW phase 2. Duke (19) roster PGY1 2012-13..PGY3 2014-15, absent Aug 2015; Rush affiliation from 2016; Rush alumni 2018. Phase 1 had reconstructed him as a 2012 Rush entrant; corrected. Recorded as transfer-in.

joiners.name: Krishna Joshi
joiners.note: absent from 2019-20 roster (would be PGY3); arrived 2020-21 or 2021-22; MBBS/MS/MCh (prior Indian neurosurgery training). Listed PGY-7 in both 2022-23 and 2023-24; alumni 2024. PubMed: Rush endovascular/neurosurgery research affiliation 2018-2020, so residency start 2020-21 is possible. Recorded as transfer-in, start 2021.

joiners.name: Vitor Salviato Nespoli
joiners.note: absent from 2023-24 roster; first in Sep 2024 capture at PGY-2 (not in Aug 2024 captures); fills the 2023 class alongside Cannon/Varela. Prior neurosurgery training at University of Sao Paulo (PubMed 2020-21). Recorded as transfer-in.

joiners.name: Daniel DiLorenzo
joiners.note: alumni 2016 graduate, never on a roster. Chain: UTMB (109) chief/research resident 2011-12 -> Houston Methodist (26) photo Nov 2013 -> first Rush affiliation on a paper accepted Mar 2014 (JNS 2014 with Rush co-authors). PGY unknown. Recorded as transfer-in, start 2014 (approx.).

joiners.name: Manish Kasliwal
joiners.note: alumni 2016 graduate ('Manisha Kumar Kasliwal'); Rush spine FELLOW 2010-11 (AIIMS residency); Rush neurosurgery affiliation from 2011; 5 years to 2016 implies entry at about PGY2 in 2011-12. Recorded as transfer-in, start 2011 (inferred).

adjudication_summary.note: Outcome-unknown pair = Ruban and Smith (2011 graduates, pre-window). Did not complete = Otun, Delgardo (outcome unknown). Transferred: Wallace -> UTHSA, Nunna -> Missouri (both correct), Morrison -> 'Buffalo' (WRONG: initial+surname match to John Morrison; his outcome is unknown). Kolcun completed 2026.

problems: 2011-12..2017-18 remain reconstructed (content block never archived). 16_adjudicate_program misattributes Joseph Morrison to Buffalo via the John Morrison alumni row (initial+surname key); shared script not edited. Transfer-in rows store start_year = year joined, which the adjudicator reads as entry year (Adogwa shows entry 2015, Nespoli 2024). OpenAlex rate-limited (daily budget used up), not used. Kazuki Sakakura PGY-1 in both 2025-26 and 2026-27. Ryan Khanna graduated after PGY6 in the 7-year era.
terminal_pgy_note: 6-year curriculum for entrants through 2012 (2010-11 PGY1s graduated 2016, 2012 entrants 2018); 7-year from 2013 entrants (graduated 2020, no 2019 graduates). Exception: Ryan Khanna (entry 2016) graduated 2022 after PGY6.

2022-2023.reason: capture omits the PGY-1 class; the 2022 class (Otun, Richards, Olson) of 3 fits the pattern and all three are on 2023-24

2026-2027.reason: live page 2026-09-28, advanced; Sakakura PGY1 in two years (repeat or stale label)
